tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.title: Get my Eclosia profile
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's Eclosia profile: first name, email, plan, premium status, current streak.

tools.name: list_journal_entries
tools.title: List my journal entries
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's most recent private journal entries, newest first. Each row has the entry content and the writing mode/prompt it was written from.

limit.description: How many entries to return (1-50, default 10).

tools.name: create_journal_entry
tools.title: Create a journal entry
tools.description: Add a new private journal entry for the signed-in user. Use for reflections, feelings, or notes the user dictates.

prompt_key.description: Optional identifier of the guided prompt used, if any.

tools.name: list_emotion_checkins
tools.title: List my emotion check-ins
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's most recent daily emotion check-ins (which emotion, of what type), newest first.

limit.description: How many check-ins to return (1-100, default 30).

tools.name: list_transformation_portraits
tools.title: List my transformation portraits
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's monthly AI-generated transformation portraits, newest first. Each portrait describes what the user has overcome, what she is developing, her new strengths, and what she is becoming.

limit.description: How many portraits to return (1-24, default 6).

tools.name: get_my_ambassador_impact
tools.title: Get my ambassador impact
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's Eclosia ambassador stats: tier, referral code, commissions earned and pending, moms accompanied, next tier progress. Only meaningful if the user is enrolled as an ambassador.
